visualArc.event: Maya spots a flicker beneath the flowerpot. It vanishes when she looks towards the sky.
Maya finds a star with its points tucked inward. She holds out one open hand.
The star climbs onto Maya's palm. When she points upward, it folds shut again.
Maya cups her hands around the star. It unfolds and blinks once against her fingers.
Maya opens her hands, closes them, and opens them again. The star answers with two small blinks.
Maya lifts the star towards the narrow patch overhead. It blinks twice, but no light answers.
The star tucks its points against Maya's thumb. She notices the wall hides the wider sky.
Maya carries the star into the open garden. She keeps one hand beside it beneath the wider sky.
The star tries two blinks from Maya's palm. Above them, two distant lights blink in reply.
Maya opens her hands; the star rises into the sky. It keeps blinking, and the distant lights keep answering.
Maya opens and closes her empty hands once more. One star blinks back above her yellow sleeves.
